title: R14: implement environment/topic startup modes and an explicit empty-room transcript (spec 9/26 calibration lever)
description:
Evidence (user's RTX 3070 Ti, qwen3:4b, 2026-10-03): 7/7 real decisions in an empty blank-mode room were WAIT (5 probe samples + gate-2 live at 2:00 and 3:50), zero failures. The engine records startup_mode but implements only blank. Spec 9 defines environment (neutral stimulus: room opened, agents joined) and topic modes; spec 26 lists agent joined / session resumed as environment events. Implement both as one descriptive environment event at a fresh session start; reject the reserved custom mode in v0.1; render '(no messages yet)' for an empty visible history (turn format v2). Default stays blank per spec.
## Acceptance Criteria
- environment mode writes one environment event '<names> are in the room' before any decision on a fresh start, none on restart; topic mode writes '(the room was opened with the topic: ...)' and requires runtime.topic; custom rejected by config; blank unchanged
- render_room_history([]) == '(no messages yet)'; TURN_FORMAT_VERSION room-transcript-v2; ENGINE_VERSION 0.1.2; checklist regime notes updated; suite green on 3.12/3.13
close_reason: Completed: commit d5d9435 (0b3d192..d5d9435); suite 306 passed, 1 skipped, 1 deselected under -W error on 3.12/3.13; review approved. Pushed as 673be1c for the gate-3 environment-mode comparison.

title: R13: real qwen3:4b decisions all fail DecisionValidationError (gate blocker); record raw content in attempt_failed
description:
Evidence from the user's RTX machine (gate-1, 2026-10-03): every real opportunity for milo and ada -> attempt_failed error_class DecisionValidationError 'Ollama decision violates schema' x2 then generation_failed; zero waits, zero messages. Hypothesis: model answers action=wait with a non-null message (schema only makes message nullable; validator demands null). Awaiting raw samples from the user. Fix candidates: (1) express the speak/wait contract in the JSON schema via oneOf so the grammar enforces it; (2) attempt_failed payload records a bounded, control-char-escaped excerpt of the raw content plus the first pydantic error line (research logging, spec 31/35).
## Acceptance Criteria
- attempt_failed payload includes raw_excerpt (<=300 chars, escaped) and error_detail; test
- schema fix verified against real samples; pytest -m ollama passes on the user's machine; a real run records waits/messages
notes:
CONFIRMED by 3 raw samples from the user's machine: Qwen returns action=wait with a filled message and target ('me','nobody','you'); validator 'wait requires a null message' rejects. Fix: per-agent two-branch schema (anyOf: speak+minLength message+target enum of other agent names|null; wait+null+null), keep pydantic as backstop, log raw excerpt in attempt_failed.
Candidate two-branch anyOf schema verified on the user's machine: 5/5 samples valid WAIT with null message/target (Ollama grammar honours anyOf/const/minLength).
close_reason: Completed: commit 0064b26 (eb85a63..0064b26); suite 282 passed, 1 skipped, 1 deselected under -W error on 3.12/3.13; pytest -m ollama skips here; review approved. Candidate schema verified on the user's machine (5/5 valid WAITs); SPEAK branch on real qwen3:4b still to be observed.

title: R11: start creates the database's parent directory and reports control state
description:
User hit: 'could not open the engine lock ~/driftroom/gate.sqlite3.engine.lock: No such file or directory' because ~/driftroom did not exist. start is the command that creates databases, so it should create the parent directory (mkdir parents, exist_ok) before taking the lock; a parent that cannot be created exits 1 with a clear message. Also print the room's control state at start (final-review M9) so a paused room is not mistaken for a silent one.
## Acceptance Criteria
- CliRunner test: start --fake into a missing nested directory succeeds and creates it; unwritable parent exits 1 with a message naming the directory; start output includes 'control: running'
close_reason: Completed: commit c883c92 (5e3677d..c883c92); suite 254 passed, 1 skipped, 1 deselected under -W error on 3.12/3.13; review approved (minors: empty dir may remain after a refused start; paused test checks a fixed event-type list)

title: DECISION: quiet-room asking cadence (final review I2)
description:
Final review measured ~5.4 model calls per simulated minute in an all-WAIT room under the default regime (elapsed urge saturates; only the 20 s decision cooldown throttles). Plan Review Focus 2 and spec 13/15/17 expect a quiet room to be computationally quiet. Options: (a) add SchedulerConfig.wait_cooldown_ms (recorded) applied after agent_wait, e.g. 60-120 s; (b) add RuntimeConfig.max_generations_per_minute (spec 17 defensive limit) enforced in the engine on simulated time; (c) keep as-is and treat as a Task 8 calibration input. Either (a) or (b) changes the recorded regime and must land before the first recorded run. User decides.
## Acceptance Criteria
- decision recorded here and in the checklist regime notes; if (a)/(b), implemented with tests and analyze_run cadence verified
notes: User decision 2026-10-03: option (a) add SchedulerConfig.wait_cooldown_ms (default 90000) applied after agent_wait; speech keeps speaker_cooldown_ms. Implemented as R10.
close_reason: Completed (R10): commit 5e3677d; wait_cooldown_ms=90000 recorded; measured all-WAIT cadence 1.68 calls/sim-min (seeds 1-5), ceiling 2.0; suite 249 passed under -W error on 3.12/3.13; review approved (wording minors: mention guarantee is 'practically always', docstring (b) also covers speech, legacy restart test name)

description: M2 realtime pacing = tick + inference latency (comment at engine.py says otherwise); M3 clock_speed has no effect in accelerated mode and does not scale the realtime tick; M4 runtime_mode is a label only; M5 decision cooldown reuses speaker_cooldown_ms/cooldown_penalty (not separately tunable); M6 elapsed-urge horizon tied to silence_ambient_after_ms (pre-existing); M7 dead code: ModelResult.model_digest always None, EventStore.append_event and Scheduler.select_candidate test-only, VirtualClock.start_wall unused, duplicated event paging in cli/analysis; M8 cooldown restore window can be hidden by failure bursts; control-interrupted generation_failed lacks score/reasons; M9 start does not print control state; stop between get/set at start is lost; M10 observer exception (e.g. BrokenPipe from start | head) propagates without session_ended; M11 bidi/U+2028 not neutralized in observer, JSONL ensure_ascii=False leaves U+2028/NEL raw, Ollama error text echoed unsanitized; M12 text export lacks a run id/fingerprint header; M15 test gaps (abrupt-exit restart, two-engine, golden hashes for trait phrases/ambient text).
